findings.title: The no-fee claim has no number behind it
findings.viewer_experience: The visitor reads "no fee on top of the hire" but sees no price to judge it against, so they must take it on trust.

current.value: no price or other boatyard fact shown near the claim

findings.target: a boatyard fact that proves the claim, such as a from-price per week for a boat at this base, shown near the intro or the form
findings.fix_direction: Show a fact that proves the claim near the intro or the form. The boatyard must supply the figure, such as a from-price per week for a boat at this base.

closed_when.check: A fresh critic sees a boatyard-supplied fact, such as a from-price, near the intro or the form in the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen viewports.

findings.title: A holiday page with no picture of the holiday
findings.viewer_experience: People hire a narrowboat for the boat and the water, and the page shows neither, so the page sells a form instead of a trip.

current.value: no photo of a boat or a route on the page

findings.target: a real photo of the boatyard's own boats or a stretch of one of the listed routes, not a stock picture
findings.fix_direction: Add a real photo in the hero. The boatyard must supply the photo of its own boats or of a listed route.

closed_when.check: A fresh critic sees a real photo of a boat or a listed route in the hero in the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen viewports.

findings.title: The start-date field looks like free text

location.description: the start date field in the search form

findings.viewer_experience: The visitor cannot tell that the field wants a picked date.

current.value: plain field holding "Sat 14 June" with no date-picker cue

findings.target: a date-input or calendar cue on the field
findings.fix_direction: Give the field a date-input or calendar cue so the visitor knows to pick a date.

closed_when.check: A fresh critic sees a date-picker or calendar cue on the start-date field in the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen viewports.

findings.title: The "See boats and dates" link leads to the same place as Search

location.description: the underlined "See boats and dates" link under the intro

findings.viewer_experience: On the phone it sits above the form and is the first action the visitor reaches, yet it does the same job as Search.

current.value: link leads to the same place as Search

findings.target: a link with a clearly different job, or no link
findings.fix_direction: Give the link a clearly different job, such as browsing all boats, or remove it.

closed_when.check: A fresh critic sees the link gone, or labeled for a different job than Search, in the phone, tablet, desktop and widescreen viewports.

findings.title: On the tablet the content column ends before the nav does

location.description: the content column on the tablet, with very wide form fields

findings.viewer_experience: The right edges of the nav and the content do not line up, and the 554 px form fields are very wide.

current.value: content column ends at x 664, nav ends at x 704

findings.target: content column and nav end at the same right edge, with shorter form fields
findings.fix_direction: Let the content take the header's full width so the right edges line up, which also shortens the 554 px form fields.

closed_when.check: A fresh critic sees the content column and the nav end at the same right edge in the tablet viewport.
